description: Reject unregistered pytest markers. Markers are declared but not enforced, so a misspelled marker is a warning — and a marker-selected job silently runs nothing.
expectedBehavior: A test carrying an undeclared marker causes the run to fail, naming the marker
The existing declared markers still select their tests
verificationSteps: Apply a misspelled marker to one test and confirm the run fails naming it, then revert
